note: Repository checks can show evidence is missing; they never close a gate that requires physical measurement, accredited testing, independent review, or ethics approval. A CLOSED gate must name its reviewer, date, and artifacts.

gates.requirement: Worst-case electrode current stays below the reviewed limit under every single fault, including a welded switch.
evidence_required: Independent worst-case calculation over resistor tolerance, rail maximum, and leakage
Bench measurement of short-circuit electrode current on an assembled board
gates.blocker: The 27.5 uA figure is a design calculation (5.5 V / 199.6 kOhm); it has not been independently reviewed or measured.
gates.closure_condition: Independent reviewer signs the calculation and a measured fault current on assembled hardware is recorded.

gates.requirement: Electrode disconnect switches open on every unsafe condition and fail open.
evidence_required: Reviewed switch part, drive circuit, and footprint
Interlock injection tests (USB, debug, expansion, low battery) on hardware
gates.blocker: Switch behavior is taken from datasheets and schematic intent only.
gates.closure_condition: Interlock injection tests pass on assembled hardware and an independent reviewer approves the design.

gates.requirement: Battery charging, protection, and undervoltage behavior stay inside cell ratings.
gates.closure_condition: Measured charge current and cutoff thresholds recorded within limits.

gates.requirement: Regulator magnetics and thermal dissipation have margin at worst-case load.
gates.blocker: Efficiency and ripple figures are datasheet-derived design targets.
gates.closure_condition: Measured ripple, efficiency, and temperature rise recorded at worst-case load.

gates.requirement: The BAT_HUMAN / LAB_ISO barrier meets the required creepage, clearance, and withstand for the intended use.
evidence_required: Creepage and clearance review against the applicable standard and pollution degree
Hipot test of the assembled barrier
gates.blocker: 5.0 kVrms is the ISOW7742 component rating. The assembled barrier has not been reviewed or tested.
gates.closure_condition: Accredited or independently witnessed withstand test on assembled boards plus reviewed creepage analysis.

gates.requirement: The optical head cable carries I2C, interrupts, and LED current without corrupting samples.
evidence_required: Bench waveform capture at the cable length used
gates.closure_condition: Measured rise times and error-free transfer over the intended cable.

gates.requirement: Every footprint matches its manufacturer land pattern and pinout.
gates.blocker: Custom footprints are generated and unreviewed.
gates.closure_condition: Signed footprint review and first-article inspection.

gates.requirement: All copper connectivity is routed; DRC contains no unexplained connectivity items.
evidence_required: Fresh KiCad DRC with zero unallowlisted violations
Every unconnected item routed or individually reviewed
gates.blocker: DRC passes only because unrouted nets are fingerprinted in an open allowlist; the boards are not routed.
gates.closure_condition: The DRC allowlist contains no unconnected_items and a reviewer approves the routed layout.

gates.requirement: Firmware implements the timing, FIFO, gap, availability, and evidence behavior the twin models.
evidence_required: Hardware-in-the-loop tests reproducing twin timing assumptions
gates.blocker: No firmware exists in this repository; the twin's firmware behavior is a specification.
gates.closure_condition: Firmware passes loopback tests matching docs/firmware-pinmap-and-init.md and the twin's timing model.

gates.requirement: Every bring-up test in the validation plan passes on assembled boards.
evidence_required: Recorded results for each bring-up step
gates.closure_condition: Recorded bench results for every step in docs/board-bringup-and-validation-plan.md.

gates.requirement: Acquisition, timing, and pipeline are validated against electrical and optical phantoms with known injected truth before any body contact.
evidence_required: Optical PPG phantom with known pulse timing
gates.blocker: Only the software twin exists; no phantom has been built.
gates.closure_condition: Phantom sessions pass the same audit and scorecard structure as the twin, with measured truth.

gates.requirement: A qualified independent reviewer approves the human-connected design for the intended research use.
gates.blocker: Automated KiCad checks are not an electrical-safety review.
gates.closure_condition: Signed independent safety review naming the reviewed revision.

gates.requirement: Emissions and immunity are acceptable for the intended environment.
gates.closure_condition: Recorded EMC test report for the tested revision.

gates.requirement: Skin-contact materials are acceptable for the intended contact duration.
gates.blocker: No contact materials or enclosures are specified.
gates.closure_condition: Evaluation report for the actual contact materials.

gates.requirement: Any human-connected session runs under an approved research protocol with informed consent.
evidence_required: Ethics / IRB approval of a specific protocol
Operator training and procedural safety rules
gates.blocker: No protocol has been submitted. Repository verification never authorizes human connection.
gates.closure_condition: Approval letter for a named protocol and hardware revision, after every other HUMAN_CONNECTION gate is closed.

gates.requirement: Resonance simulations run matched geometry, core, sham, and unpowered controls with identical physics and measurement logic.
gates.blocker: Simulation controls are implemented; this gate stays open until a preregistered confirmatory plan with multiple-comparison correction is reviewed.
gates.closure_condition: Reviewed preregistered analysis plan that names every compared condition and its correction.

gates.requirement: The resonance apparatus has no conductive path to BAT_HUMAN; synchronization crosses only the isolated SYNC interface.
evidence_required: Withstand and continuity test of the assembled setup
gates.closure_condition: Measured isolation of the assembled apparatus and reviewer approval.

gates.requirement: Any apparent response is shown not to be instrumentation pickup: it must be absent on resistor, optical, disconnected, shielded, and dummy-load phantoms.
evidence_required: Phantom sweeps under the identical drive conditions
gates.closure_condition: Phantom results recorded for every drive condition used in a human or biological claim.
